decisions.reason: The vertigo combination tablet sits close to the firm's established prescription portfolio, so the firm can interpret its early results and refine it with its own formulation know-how, and it has a dedicated page signalling commitment.

The generic antidepressant capsule is distant from the firm's core knowledge, which limits how well it can learn from and improve it, but it was only launched in 2024 and has its own page, and regulatory approval costs in German generics favour keeping it for now.

The combination antihypertensive line builds directly on the firm's established cardiovascular and formulation expertise, and several models plus a dedicated page show an investment the firm can absorb and extend.

The bone and joint supplement builds on existing self-care knowledge and fits the strategy of pharmacy-exclusive health products, though its mere mention on the website suggests lower priority and some risk of pruning.
